name.en: Supine figure-four stretch with planted foot

purpose.zh: 仰卧右踝搭左大腿，左脚踩地，温和拉伸右侧臀部
purpose.en: Stretch the right buttock gently with the right ankle crossed over the left thigh and the left foot planted.

text.zh: 右脚踝搭在左大腿上，左脚踩地，双手放松在体侧
text.en: Rest your right ankle over your left thigh, keep your left foot planted and relax your arms beside you

text.zh: 头肩自然承托，右膝向外保持舒适幅度
text.en: Let the head and shoulders rest comfortably, with the right knee open through a comfortable range.

text.zh: 只轻柔加深右侧臀部拉伸，不用手压右膝
text.en: Deepen the right-buttock stretch gently without pressing on the right knee.

text.zh: 慢慢减轻拉伸，片内保持同一侧，不抱腿拉向胸口
text.en: Ease the stretch slowly, keep the same side throughout the clip and do not pull the thigh towards the chest.

commonErrors.zh: 照搬抱腿版口令，双手强拉腿或按压右膝
commonErrors.en: Following the pulled-thigh version by yanking the leg or pressing the right knee.

commonErrors.zh: 左脚滑动、拱腰，或通过扭膝凑更深位置
commonErrors.en: Sliding the left foot, arching the back or twisting the knee to force more range.

items.zh: 右膝与踝：踝部搭在对侧大腿，不把直接压膝作为加深方法。
items.en: Right knee and ankle: rest the ankle on the opposite thigh without pressing directly on the knee to deepen the stretch.

items.zh: 腰背与髋：左脚稳定，头肩舒适承托，只到温和无痛范围。
items.en: Lower back and hips: keep the left foot stable and the head and shoulders supported, using only a gentle pain-free range.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制仰卧、盘腿搭踝或髋外旋时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if supine exercise, ankle-over-thigh positioning or hip external rotation has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One gentle right-side deepen-and-ease demonstration occurs per8-second loop. The left foot remains floor-locked and both hands stay on the mat. Preserve default30 seconds and range, with proposed per-side interpretation editorial pending; this is not a30-second static hold, a pulled-thigh variation or a promise of zero knee torque. There is no in-clip side switch.
definition.movementSides: Right ankle crosses the left thigh; right buttock is stretched. Left foot stays planted. Optional change only after the completed side dose; no mirror is produced.
editorialNotes: 旧目录“抱住大腿拉向胸口”与实际源不符；新主点明确脚踩地、手放垫，不复用旧主点。拟名带脚踩地版供编辑确认，稳定ID不变。
原源注释称左脚向髋走6cm，但实际pose.deltas没有left-foot变化，只有右踝小幅位移和knee-pole变化；以代码为准，不把旧注释当运动证据。
10/19审查明确只有原机位能看清脚踝跨膝，故保留原机位；不为露高亮换掉动作辨识。
删除旧用途“膝不受扭力/膝不适可替代鸽子”的无条件安全宣称。s-9090仅作同臀部拉伸目标、不同坐姿要求的候选关系，降阶/进阶独立ID未核定。
本稿保留旧目录剂量数字和范围。rhythm描述真实8秒示范，不把短演示循环当作已完成持续时间处方；需要专业编辑确认播放/计数。
主要/协同肌群含姿势稳定或次要拉伸角色，未作肌电定量结论；动作关系是现有ID候选，不能自动消费旧模型媒体。
通用禁用筛查依据catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md及AAOS髋/脊柱康复资料；具体到各动作的应用是待审编辑推断，没有疾病特异绝对禁忌或临床适用性批准。
